description:

Concept plans and preliminary designs are ready for review. The sellers are actively working on finalizing these entitlements; buy now at $269,000 in As-Is condition before the price increases once entitlements are fully secured. 

Highly attractive for investors looking to deploy c capital gains, this property is situated within a Qualified Opportunity Zone (QOZ), with adjacent parcels along Portland Street sharing the same active status.

Alternatively, choose to rehab and flip the existing structure in this rapidly up-and-coming neighborhood. The current detached character home features 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and 1,264 sq ft of potential. Unparalleled urban convenience--just minutes from the Loop 202 and I-10 freeways, downtown dining, nightlife, and schools. Opportunity knocks loud here--bring your vision and capture the upside!

description:
Fully remodeled and professionally designed, this stunning home in the sought after FQ Story Historic District masterfully blends timeless character with modern luxury. Offering 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, every inch of this home reflects thoughtful craftsmanship, from the custom tile in the kitchen, living area, and baths to the designer finishes throughout. The kitchen and bathrooms feature custom cabinetry with above standard storage capacity, maximizing every square foot of this efficiently designed home. The primary suite delivers a true spa inspired retreat, while each bedroom opens to its own private patio, a rare and sought-after feature. Natural light flows throughout, complemented by Levelor blinds and curated window treatments. The dining area is anchored by a striking designer light fixture, adding an elevated finishing touch.
Situated on a large corner lot, the property is an entertainer's dream. The expansive 18x16 gazebo (288 sq ft) functions as a three-season bonus room and not included in the stated square footage, offering additional living and entertaining space you won't find anywhere else. A 2+ car garage with a dedicated 7x14 storage area (98 sq ft) rounds out this exceptionally functional property.
Ideally located close to downtown Phoenix, premier dining, and local favorites, this is FQ Story living at its finest.

description:
Centrally located historic 1926 Burroughs home is full of charm, character, and timeless personality. Enjoy a piece of history with this beautifully crafted red-brick residence, featuring an inviting front porch and a relaxing patio area in the rear. Inside, you'll find original oak hardwood floors, a wood-burning fireplace, ceiling fans throughout, and stunning wood-planked ceilings in the living and dining rooms.
Two bedroom one bath with a living room, dining room, and a addition at the back of the home. Set on a 7,500-square-foot lot, with a large backyard and a detached workshop/shed that is perfect for projects or storage. A rare opportunity to own a piece of Phoenix history in one of the city's most vibrant, central locations.  Situated near downtown Phoenix, this home places you close to everything: the Phoenix Theatre, Art Museum, Heard Museum, sporting venues, coffee shops, dining, shopping, Wilderness Brewing Co., Banner University, light rail, and I 10 access.
